description: Serves a pols.so site at a subdomain of the domain (for example www.example.com): a CNAME to the site's on.pols.so host, and the TXT record that proves control of the host.
variableDescription: %site%: the name of the pols.so site, which is served at %site%.on.pols.so; %token%: the host's verification token, shown on the site's Domains tab
